---
name: Bug report
about: Report something that does not work

labels: bug, triage
assignees: ''
---

**Describe the bug**
A clear description of what happened.

**Steps to reproduce**
1. Open the app

blank_issues_enabled: false
contact_links:
  - name: Discussions
    url: https://github.com/octo-org/hello-mobile/discussions
    about: Ask questions here

name: Crash report
description: Attach a crash log
labels: [bug]
body:
  - type: input
    id: version
    attributes:
      label: App version
  - type: upload
    id: log
    attributes:
      label: Crash log

name: Feature request
description: Suggest an idea for GH Mobile+
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: ["enhancement"]
body:
  - type: markdown
    attributes:
      value: Thanks for taking the time to suggest a feature!
  - type: input
    id: summary
    attributes:
      label: Summary
      description: One line describing the feature.
      placeholder: Swipe to archive in Inbox
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: textarea
    id: details
    attributes:
      label: Details
      render: markdown
  - type: dropdown
    id: platforms
    attributes:
      label: Platforms
      multiple: true
      options:
        - iOS
        - Android
  - type: checkboxes
    id: terms
    attributes:
      label: Checklist
      options:
        - label: I searched existing issues
          required: true
        - label: I can help implement this
